name: VALERIANA OFFICINALIS
key_symptoms: Hunger, with nausea. Eructations foul. Heartburn with gulping of rancid fluid. Nausea, with faintness. Child vomits curdled milk in large lumps after nursing.
Sensation of great coldness. Pressure in forehead. Feeling of intoxication.
Choking on falling asleep. Spasmodic asthma; convulsive movements of the diaphragm.
Rheumatic pains in limbs. Constant jerking. Heaviness. Sciatica; pain worse standing and resting on floor (Bell); better walking. Pain in heels when sitting.
guiding_symptoms: Hunger, with nausea. Eructations foul. Heartburn with gulping of rancid fluid. Nausea, with faintness. Child vomits curdled milk in large lumps after nursing.
Sensation of great coldness. Pressure in forehead. Feeling of intoxication.
Choking on falling asleep. Spasmodic asthma; convulsive movements of the diaphragm.
mind_symptoms: Changeable disposition. Feels light, as if floating in air. Over-sensitiveness (Staph). Hallucinations at night. Irritable. Tremulous.
head_symptoms: Sensation of great coldness. Pressure in forehead. Feeling of intoxication.
respiratory_symptoms: Choking on falling asleep. Spasmodic asthma; convulsive movements of the diaphragm.
gi_symptoms: Hunger, with nausea. Eructations foul. Heartburn with gulping of rancid fluid. Nausea, with faintness. Child vomits curdled milk in large lumps after nursing.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Rheumatic pains in limbs. Constant jerking. Heaviness. Sciatica; pain worse standing and resting on floor (Bell); better walking. Pain in heels when sitting.
sleep_symptoms: Sleepless, with nightly itching and muscular spasms. Worse on waking.
fever_symptoms: Long lasting heat, often with sweat on face. Heat predominates. Sensation of icy coldness (Heloderma; Camp; Abies c).
